verses.1: And he went back into the gathering again. There, there was a man with a withered hand.
verses.2: And they will also consider whether he will heal him on Saturdays, so that they can accuse him of doing so.
verses.3: And he said to the man who had a dry hand, “Bring it to the middle.”
verses.4: And he said to them, “Is it useful for people to do good on Saturdays, or to do evil? Is it beneficial for them to preserve their souls, or to destroy them?” But they refused to listen.
verses.5: And looking at them with anger in his eyes, he took hold of their hearts. He said to that man, “Clench your hands together.” And they indeed clenched their hands together.
verses.6: And when the Pharisees left, they immediately gave advice to the Herodians on how to get rid of him.
verses.7: And Jesus, along with his disciples, set out towards the sea. A large crowd from Galilee followed him. There were also people from Judea who came to join them.
verses.8: And from Jerusalem and from Judea, as well as beyond the Jordan River, around Tyre and Sidon, a large number of people came to him, listening to what he said.
verses.9: And he said to his disciples, “Let them prepare a ship for him, so that he might cross over with them, so that they won’t suffer.”
verses.10: For he cured many people, so that they would worship him, as those who had diseases were healed by him.
verses.11: And those impure spirits, when they saw him, rushed towards him and said, “You are indeed the son of God.”
verses.12: And many other things were done to them, so that they wouldn’t be able to reveal him.
verses.13: And he goes up to the mountain, and he invites those he wanted to have with him. And they come to him.
verses.14: And he made twelve, so that they could follow him and be sent out to spread his message.
verses.15: And he has the power to expel demons.
verses.16: And he created twelve of them. Then he gave them the name Simon Peter.
verses.17: And Iacob, the son of Zebedaeus, and Iuan, his brother. They were also given the names “Boanerges”, which means “Sons of Thunder”.
verses.18: And Andréean, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Maththai, and Thomas, and Jacob, the son of Alfaius, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite.
verses.19: And Judas Iscariot also, whom he also gave over to them.
verses.20: And he goes into the house. Once again, the crowd gathers around him, so that they can’t even eat any bread.
verses.21: And when those who were with him heard that they had to take him away, they said that he was being taken away.
verses.22: And the scribes who came from Jerusalem said that Bethlehem also has someone who can exorcise demons. They said that this person is the leader of the demons.
verses.23: And by using metaphors, he invited them to listen. He said to them, “How can Satan send someone from Satan’s own domain?”
verses.24: And if the kingdom itself divides into parts, then that kingdom cannot remain intact.
verses.25: And if a house becomes self-sufficient, then that house will not be able to stand on its own.
verses.26: And even if Satan rises up from himself and becomes powerful, he still cannot succeed; he has a destined end.
verses.27: But no one can enter the house of a strong man and steal his goods, unless he first overpowers that strong man first. And then, he will indeed steal his goods.
verses.28: I tell you that all the sins and insults that people commit will be forgiven.
verses.29: Whoever blasphemes against the holy spirit has no right to enter into the kingdom of heaven. Instead, he is guilty of eternal sin.
verses.30: Because they said: “It has impure spirit.”
verses.31: And his mother and brothers came, standing outside, and called out to him.
verses.32: And a crowd gathered around him. They said to him, “Look! Your mother and your brothers are waiting for you outside.”
verses.33: And after answering them, he said, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
verses.34: And looking at those who were sitting around him, he said, “Look, my mother and my brothers!”
verses.35: For he who fulfills the will of God, that person is my brother, sister, and mother as well.
